input: tops and bottoms are equal-length nonempty lists of n integers in [1,6], with 1 <= n <= 20000. Entry i in each list describes the two faces of the same domino. Integer inputs are plain int values excluding bool. Containers are ordinary lists and strings are ordinary str values, without subclasses or overloaded behavior. No concurrent mutation or modified standard built-ins are allowed. Preconditions are not dynamically validated. Size bounds do not guarantee available memory or completion within an unqualified runtime budget.
return: The minimum number of individual domino swaps needed to make every top face equal or every bottom face equal, or -1 if impossible. Return the count only, not swapped arrays.
mutation_aliasing: Both lists and their entries remain unchanged, even if the caller passes the same container for both. A helper counts hypothetical top/bottom changes without swapping any values. The Solution instance retains no state; separate calls share no mutable result state.
numeric: Counts are in [0,n]; the impossible sentinel n+1 is at most 20001. Both target candidates are faces of the first domino, so at least one must be the common value in any successful arrangement. All arithmetic and comparisons are exact.
complexity: At most two O(n) scans and O(1) auxiliary/output space. Repeated first-domino values may cause a redundant scan, still within the bound. Both orientation counts and early impossibility checks are included.

helpers.name: rotations
helpers.contract: For one candidate common face, reject any domino lacking it; otherwise count rotations to make the top uniform and to make the bottom uniform, returning the smaller count. Return n+1 when impossible.
helpers.cost: The complete helper definition is 437 UTF-8 bytes including indentation and terminal newline, already included in the total source. O(n) time and O(1) space per call; both complete scans and their early exits are charged.
